dinkum-3.meaning: Every duty, condition and qualification kept, numbers and dates exact. The gloss "AFGE Council 260, so it's a union job" slightly overstates a bargaining unit position; "no worries:" is colour.
dinkum-3.sense: Terms fit: "Get your head around what customers need", "Have a squiz at that announcement", "nutting out production problems", "on your CV", "new starters", "pro rata".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Reads like an Australian job ad: "all the program goals get ticked off", "Know your way around the technical resources", "spot on".
dinkum-3.register: Level 3: conversational and local throughout, without turning the notice into a yarn; no swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: Stays a clear, official-but-friendly job notice; requirements still read as requirements ("You'll need to pass a background check.").
dinkum-3.flow: Mostly smooth; "so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on" is a little ungrammatical.
dinkum-3.variety: Varied; "properly" recurs as in the original ("Handle ... properly", "look after them properly", "use them properly").

engine.meaning: The original text with spelling changes and "new starters", so nothing lost or changed.
engine.sense: The few changes fit: "new starters", "pro rata basis", "specialised".
engine.authenticity: Hardly any Aussie to judge; spelling is mixed, "Specialized Experience" then "specialised experience" in the same line.
engine.register: Left essentially untranslated: "Properly manipulate the contents of documents", "Please refer to that announcement". Far under level 3.
engine.flow: Reads as the original, including its own slip "prior to developed for publication".

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every point kept; the clumsy education clause clarified ("2 full years of graduate study, each year at a higher level"). Nothing invented.
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "learn the whole box and dice", "all program goals get ticked off", "Have a squiz", "on offer too".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural and unforced: "There's the chance to work from home (telework)", "look after it properly".
yarn-dinkum.register: Level 3, a touch light: several duty lines stay formal ("Understand and properly use the technical resources on hand"). Keeps "résumé" rather than CV.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Official but approachable, as the original.
yarn-dinkum.variety: Slang used sparingly, little repetition; "Specialized Experience" heading kept beside "specialised".

unharnessed.meaning: All content kept, plainly reworded; nothing added.
unharnessed.sense: Fits: "ticked off", "postgrad degree", "new hire" left, "work eligibility".
unharnessed.authenticity: Plain casual English more than Australian; "You've gotta pass a background check" and "You've gotta meet these requirements" lean American.
unharnessed.register: Closer to level 2: casual register but little Australian vocabulary beyond "ticked off" and "postgrad".
unharnessed.variety: "gotta" twice and "Have a look at" twice; little slang to vary.

yarn-troppo.meaning: All requirements kept, but additions creep in: "legacy systems (the old clunkers that still have to keep running)", "No way round that one.", "Not the day after.", "so the union's in the picture", "Not bad, ay?".
yarn-troppo.sense: Mostly fit ("toe the line on style and formatting", "nutting out", "over the line"), but "leading the pack" for leading others and "Wrangle the contents" strain.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Real idiom, but some stock openers and tags: "Righto", "no dramas", "Not bad, ay?".
yarn-troppo.register: Heavier than level 3: chatty asides added to nearly every section.
yarn-troppo.tone: An official notice made jokey in places ("Not the day after.", "Not bad, ay?"), undercutting the requirements.
yarn-troppo.flow: Readable, but the tag lines interrupt: "You've got to pass a background check. No way round that one."
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the announcement, but the asides change its character toward a pitch.

dinkum-3.quote: so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on
dinkum-3.original: to ensure legally effective, timely, and accurate publication of them

dinkum-3.quote: AFGE Council 260, so it's a union job
dinkum-3.original: This is a bargaining unit position, AFGE Council 260.
dinkum-3.why: A bargaining unit position is covered by a union agreement; union job overstates it slightly.

engine.quote: Properly manipulate the contents of documents and of Federal Register publications
engine.original: Properly manipulate the contents of documents and of Federal Register publications
engine.why: Left untranslated throughout; far short of the brief.

engine.quote: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you must have one year of specialised experience
engine.original: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you must have one year of specialized experience

unharnessed.quote: You've gotta pass a background check.
unharnessed.original: Must successfully complete a background investigation.
unharnessed.why: Gotta reads American; got to would be local.

yarn-troppo.quote: (the old clunkers that still have to keep running)
yarn-troppo.why: Invented gloss that disparages the agency's systems.
Salesy tag that changes the notice's tone.
Added aside; flippant about a formal deadline.
Means being ahead of others, not leading a team.

summaries.dinkum-3: Natural, well-pitched level-3 job ad that keeps every requirement.
summaries.engine: Essentially untranslated; only spelling and a word or two changed.
summaries.yarn-dinkum: Faithful, clean and natural; a slightly light level 3.
summaries.unharnessed: Faithful plain-English rewrite, under the level asked and more casual than Australian.
summaries.yarn-troppo: Varied and lively, but heavier than asked and jokey in places, with invented asides.
